relationships.province: One existing TerritoryId / operational cell. Runtime country row maps cellOrdinal, cellId, administrativeOrdinal and previousParentOrdinal. Never create ProvinceId from a name or ordinal.
relationships.state: Verified macro hierarchy and existing administrative parent identity are inputs to 20-02. Preserve parentKey, macroId, sourceFeatureId and sourceVersion separately: synthetic runtime sourceFeatureId can differ from raw ADM1 sourceFeatureId (notably KOR/PRK). Coarse parents remain registered coarse geography.
relationships.sourceRegion: Normalized fineSourceIdentity {sourceId,sourceFeatureId}, sourceVersion and properties.name in the current fixed bundle join to source-lock normalizedInput and the country hierarchy. One source feature may span multiple current cells; group IDs from this exact join.
relationships.sourceToCellJoin: provenance.inputs[0] -> bundle.features[].id -> features[].properties.fineSourceIdentity -> lock.normalizedInput.features[].properties; bundle.records[].id -> current metadata cellId. Delivery polygon features intentionally omit these source/name properties.
relationships.administrativeMembership: Current metadata rows are authoritative for existing runtime membership. parents.start/count are presentation hints, not a contiguous ordinal range. Validate exact members and country against hierarchy; residual kind is not an official state.
relationships.seedLineage: previousParentOrdinal -> parents.previous[].oldTerritoryId and seedParentIds initialize owner/controller only. A record seedParentIds may be a subset of the representative previous parent union; never use seed lineage as state/city evidence.
relationships.displayGroup: CHN renderProvinceId is a separate presentation classification with administrativeTruthClaim:false; it cannot resolve unassigned canonical parents.
relationships.mutableState: TerritoryEntityV3 stores id, sourceCountryId, ownerCountryId and controllerCountryId. Static names/membership stay outside the mutable world; current ownership comes from the supplied world snapshot.

currentReadPaths.behavior: Pointer -> byte-checked artifact index -> descriptor/detail index -> metadata/parents -> loadCountry. worldContract validates complete catalog-order root. Process singleton uses current.json imported constants; switching current requires coordinated reload.
Exact current version uses createOperationalRegionIndex and full ref match; omitted/legacy ref uses the frozen prompt14 source path. Do not silently reinterpret old subdivision references.

Indexes administrative AND residual parents only. Names from region-names by parent.sourceFeatureId plus PRK localized macro names; membership from exact country rows, independent of owner/controller. Search: NFKC, lower case, trimmed query, substring, at most 8 results without truncation/coverage metadata. resolve cap <=512.

Record: ref,parentCountryId,nameKo,nameEn,aliases,territoryIds,provenanceIds. Ref from strict subdivisionReferenceSchema: catalogId,sourceVersion,subdivisionId. Current sourceVersion is geometryRoot. No separate metadataRef, kind, source-name quality, parent certainty or geographic coverage fields. Effect resolution enforces total 512 cells and 8 distinct refs.

Requires full catalogRef,countryId,operation. reference+membership uses lookup; action uses resolve. Search returns one or bounded ambiguous candidates. List limit <=128 and clipped. Compact responses hardcode materializable:true and omit quality/coverage.

Read-only wrappers around the same index. find_region compact strips aliases/provenance; list <=128 with clipped and materializable:true; resolve enforces action cap. Name lookup grants no territory authority.
Session injects regionIndex; prepared canonical context cached by base pair identity and targetDate. Context list <=128 with materializable:false. No metadata version key yet.
Loads index using context.regionCatalog; checks full catalog ref and current-world revision for frontier calls. Tool execution and context-resolution validation share the loaded index.
Clips country/territory directories; omitted geography must remain available through host tools. Add future geography quality to the shared schema and compact projections together.
Checks region catalog refs and revisions, resolves IDs and validates authority separately. Keep atomic commit, ownership and action caps unchanged.
Validates consensus of all representative seed parents before initializing new World V3 territories. Never reads an existing user game as metadata input.
Uses mutable owner/controller with catalogRef, world revision and delta checks. Geography metadata does not replace these checks.
